story.summaryEn:
Austin's car culture brought thousands to Road to the Race, united by a love of all things automotive.
Alongside @astonmartin, we joined the line-up last night and met the community whose passion brings this gathering to life. Thank you for welcoming us into your world.
#USGP
detailZh:
奥斯汀汽车文化吸引了数千人参加赛车之旅，与阿斯顿·马丁共同庆祝赛车热情。
昨晚，我们加入了阵容，并遇到了那些热情使这次聚会充满活力的社区。感谢你们欢迎我们进入你们的世界。
#USGP
